worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.summary: Take a regal steel stance and block enemy damaging moves with a total pool, sharpening the Attack of contact attackers; status moves still land, and the shield falls when the pool is spent or its time runs out.
worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.descriptio: The shield lasts %1$s and holds %2$s points: it blocks enemy damaging moves aimed at you, letting any excess beyond the remaining pool through, while status moves are not stopped. A contact attacker that meets the shield has its Attack lowered by %3$s levels, once per attacker per shield. Higher Defence and Speed keep the stance up longer; higher Special Defence and current health make it thicker.

Repeat-use failure rate %1$s: raising the shield again soon after makes failure more likely, and the count resets after a pause. With Majesty on, the contact Attack drop is +1 level, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85 and recovery 7 ticks; with it off (Bulwark), pool x1.25, duration x1.15, recovery 5 ticks, and no extra drop.
worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.use.0: Block melee damage and soften the attacker
worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.use.1: Weaken a foe before the next exchange
worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.use.2: Soak a volley with the thickest shield
worldcombat.skill.kingsshield.preference: On (majesty): contact drop +1, but pool x0.8, duration x0.85, recover 7 ticks. Off (bulwark): pool x1.25, duration x1.15, recover 5 ticks, but no extra drop.
Raise once a threat enters this range. Larger sets up earlier but may waste the cast; smaller saves PP but may be too late.
